g.text: Most chosen settings sit at the edge of the grid

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot per substation and arm (D5, D9, D10, D11, D14, D16). The dashed line is the grid's lowest transient sd. Every GRID cell touches an edge of the grid: five sit at the lowest transient sd, and five at the highest decay factor (0.98 per half-hour) or the lowest (0.73, D10).'
text.tspan: One dot per substation and arm (D5, D9, D10, D11, D14, D16). The dashed line is the grid's lowest
transient sd. Every GRID cell touches an edge of the grid: five sit at the lowest transient sd, and five
at the highest decay factor (0.98 per half-hour) or the lowest (0.73, D10).
